meta.name: digital-avatar-shopping-video
meta.description: 电商运营与自媒体创作者在需要制作商品推荐或促销带货短视频时，使用此技能可一键生成“小省导购员”数字人口播视频。系统自动协同五大智能体完成脚本、画面与音画合成，产出适配抖音、快手等平台的成品，高效搞定带货视频制作。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入商品信息，自动产出数字人带货短视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你做电商或自媒体，需要快速生成商品推荐视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn product info into ready-to-post avatar shopping videos
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you create product promo videos regularly for e-commerce or social media

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按需求对接、脚本、口播、画面、音画合成五个环节，产出“小省导购员”数字人口播带货视频，交付 MP4 竖屏成品、脚本原文和商品信息总结，同类商品需求先调取知识库素材。
howto.when: 当你需要生成带货视频、产品推荐视频或价格对比视频时触发。

say.text: 推荐几款2000-3000元的性价比手机，做条60秒带货视频
say.note: 先查知识库，无匹配再走脚本到合成流程

say.text: 对比京东和淘宝的Nike男鞋价格，做成45秒视频
say.note: 输出分屏价格对比画面加口播

say.text: 618大促推荐爆款家电，做个90秒促销视频
say.note: 有同类素材时直接调取框架改写

howto.what_en: Claude runs five agent steps (demand intake, script, voiceover, visuals, mixing) to make a "Xiaosheng" avatar shopping video, delivering MP4 vertical, script and product summary; similar requests reuse the knowledge base.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need a shopping video, a product-recommendation video or a price-comparison video.

say_en.text: Recommend 2000-3000 yuan value phones in a 60-second video
say_en.note: Checks the knowledge base first, then runs the pipeline

say_en.text: Compare Nike men's shoe prices on JD and Taobao in a 45-second video
say_en.note: Outputs split-screen price comparison with voiceover
Reuses an existing framework if similar material exists
